about.title: Building excellence, creating lasting value
about.lead: Every successful project begins with a clear vision and ends with exceptional execution.
about.body1: Through integrated project management, construction and premium interior design, SAAD International Projects W.L.L. delivers work that balances quality, precision and efficiency.
about.body2: We aim to create inspiring environments that exceed expectations, and to build long-term relationships based on trust and professionalism.

services.title: Every stage of the build, under one roof
services.lead: One accountable team from first sketch to final handover, so nothing gets lost between designer and contractor.

contracting.title: General contracting
contracting.body: Full site delivery for residential and commercial buildings, on programme and to specification.

designBuild.title: Design & build
designBuild.body: Architecture, engineering and construction in one contract, with a single point of responsibility.

projectManagement.title: Project management
projectManagement.body: Schedules, budgets, procurement and quality control handled for you, with clear progress reporting.

interiorDesign.title: Interior design
interiorDesign.body: Premium interiors and finishes, planned with the build so the details land as designed.

process.title: How we work
process.lead: A simple four-step process, with one team accountable at every stage.

1.title: Brief and site visit
1.body: We listen, walk the site and agree the scope, budget and timeline with you.

2.title: Design and pricing
2.body: Drawings, specifications and a fixed cost plan you can review before anything starts.

3.title: Build and manage
3.body: Our site teams deliver to programme, with regular progress reports and quality checks.

4.title: Handover and care
4.body: Final inspection, documentation and support after you move in.
